# function: inspector2_code_security_scan_configuration

Builds the ARN of an `inspector2` `Code Security Scan Configuration`:

```
arn:${Partition}:inspector2:${Region}:${Account}:owner/${OwnerId}/codesecurity-configuration/${CodeSecurityScanConfigurationId}
```

`${Partition}`, `${Region}` and `${Account}` come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
inspector2_code_security_scan_configuration(owner_id string, code_security_scan_configuration_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `owner_id` (String) Value for `${OwnerId}` in the ARN template.
1. `code_security_scan_configuration_id` (String) Value for `${CodeSecurityScanConfigurationId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given.
